item_short_desc: Rothco's 80MM Locking Carabiner is a versatile and reliable tool for securing your outdoor essentials. Made from high-strength aluminum, this carabiner is designed to withstand heavy loads while remaining lightweight and easy to carry. The secure threaded barrel lock ensures that your items stay safely attached, making it ideal for carrying keys, securing accessories, and adding to your camping gear. The durable aluminum construction offers long-lasting performance, resisting wear and tear even in harsh outdoor conditions.
